## Mandatory repair-and-retest checklist
- [ ] Investigated actual failures and repaired root causes; repeated testing after repair.
- [ ] Reused proven code where appropriate; checked compatibility and rights.
- [ ] Verified AI-assisted source leads independently; no fabricated data.
- [ ] Targeted and applicable regression tests passed on the exact commit.
- [ ] Real-data acceptance passed, with coverage and remaining gaps (or explicitly N/A).
- [ ] Preserved safety gates, project isolation, privacy, and ₹0 additional spend.
- [ ] Deployment and live receipt verified if applicable and authorized; otherwise state pending/N/A.

## Evidence and remaining work
- Exact commit SHA:

- Live data / deployment / receipt evidence:
- Unresolved blocker and attempted alternatives:

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for every task and test. A failed test triggers investigation, repair and retest, not completion. Do not mark unchecked requirements as passed.
